overview_description.description:
Snoonu is a personal concierge and delivery company based in Qatar.
Snoonu was launch in two phases:  Phase one, launched in April 2019 focuses on offline services personal concierge and door to door delivery. Phase two, launched in October 2019 involves using the snoonu mobile eCommerce application to order products online.  Snoonu will expand into a fully functional eCommerce website.
The delivery fee ranges from QR 10 and above depending on the customer’s location.
